description: This file defines classes related to monitoring aggregation dimensions for receivers, cache, and block pools within the Orleans streaming platform. It includes data structures with properties and constructors used to identify various monitoring contexts.

classes.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents monitoring dimensions for a receiver, primarily identified by a queue ID.

classes.name: CacheMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Extends ReceiverMonitorDimensions to include a block pool ID for cache monitoring.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents monitoring dimensions for a block pool, identified by a block pool ID.

methods.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a specific queue ID.

methods.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Default constructor, possibly used for serialization or default initialization.

methods.name: CacheMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a queue ID and a block pool ID.

methods.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a block pool ID.
